create_sinusoidal_position_encoder: create a SinusoidalPositionEncoder with a given encoding_dim and max_seq_len for fixed sinusoidal positional encoding
create_learned_position_encoder: create a LearnedPositionEncoder with trainable positional embeddings for a given encoding_dim and max_seq_len
create_rotary_encoder: create a RotaryEncoder with configurable theta for rotary positional encoding using complex number multiplication
create_dual_rotary_encoder: create a DualRotaryEncoder with separate theta values for short-range and long-range positional encoding
create_interpolated_position_encoder: create a Sinusoidal2dPositionEncoder or Sinusoidal3dPositionEncoder for interpolated positional encoding of 2D or 3D inputs
